assetBrief: SUBJECT: a stylized diorama of a single green plant in clean soil, shown with clear informational marks: a golden arrow from a small sun down to the leaves (sunlight capture), a sugar-dot forming in the leaf (food-making), water drops rising at the roots, and a chain-link symbol at the base showing it is the start of the food chain. Warm off-white background, muted greens and paper tones, no glow. Named nodes: Plant, Sun, Leaf, SugarDot, WaterDrops, Soil, ChainLink. Budget 8-12k.
